headline: Ecolab (ECL) Could Be 12% Undervalued After Its Dividend Affirmation
summary: Ecolab dividend affirmation and what it means for shareholders Ecolab (ECL) has affirmed a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.73 per share, payable on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 15, marking 89 consecutive years of cash dividends. headline: Ecolab (ECL) Stock Looks Overvalued As Its 60% Three Year Run Continues
summary: Ecolab's share price has delivered a 59.6% total return over the past three years, yet the stock now screens as expensive on most checks while the intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model points to something closer to fair value. That mix leaves investors weighing a strong track record against signals that the current price may already bake in a lot of good news.
